# Jengara

Jengara is an independent AI strategy and transformation advisory based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Jengara connects strategic advice with hands-on engineering through two practices, Jengara Advisory and Jengara Labs. It helps enterprise leaders, boards and investors turn AI investment into measurable business performance.

Contact: hello@jengara.ai
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands

## Key facts

- Independent advisory. Recommendations are never tied to software, cloud or equipment resale.
- Two practices: Jengara Advisory (executive counsel, diligence, transformation leadership) and Jengara Labs (applied research and engineering).
- Senior led. Expertise grounded in more than 15 years across global technology platforms and infrastructure.
- Serves enterprise leaders, boards and investors.
- Publishes evidence first research on AI economics, infrastructure and diligence at https://jengara.ai/insights/.

## Frequently asked questions

- What does Jengara do? Jengara helps enterprise leaders, boards and investors turn AI investment into measurable business performance through independent strategy, transformation and engineering.
- Where is Jengara based? Amsterdam, Netherlands.
- How is Jengara structured? Two practices: Jengara Advisory for executive counsel and diligence, and Jengara Labs for applied research and engineering.
- Is Jengara independent? Yes. Recommendations are not tied to software, cloud or equipment resale.
- How can I contact Jengara? Email hello@jengara.ai or use https://jengara.ai/contact/.
